To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a new system is presented for automatic recognition of upper face expressions based both on permanent facial features and transient facial features; (b) a multi-state facial component model is developed for modeling different facial features and for tracking facial expressions; (c) a new neural network is developed for facial expression recognition; (d) a recognition rate of 93% is achieved for the test data which include both single action unit and AU combinations.

we develop an automatic system that recognizes 7 upper-face AUs based on both permanent and transient facial features, and the system achieves a high recognition rate of 90% on test data that include 7 single AUs, 3 combinations of 2 AUs, and 1 combination of 3 AUs.
we have developed a system that can automatically recognize subtle changes in upper facial expressions in a video sequence.
